photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 14:55:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 296 s; on-screen clock 04/27/13 14:55:50, wanted 14:55:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT13-116  MSG14:55-15:02' on 2013-04-26 (`as run matrix!B109`), read as 2013-04-26 14:55. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-04-26 plus one day, 14:55: it was found 246 s into this video, and in no other video. The fan setting on screen (65) is one the matrix's fan cell gives ('65', `as run matrix!J109`).
